name: Ine Funaya Boathouses
description: A unique coastal village featuring 230 traditional wooden boathouses built directly over Ine Bay's water level. Often called 'the Venice of Japan', visitors can take sea taxi boat tours.
notes: Sea taxi boat tours operate daily from Ine port.
notesJa: 【見どころ】海に直接浮かんでいるように見える230軒の伝統的舟屋群です。
reservation: Sea taxi tours available on site
reservationJa: 【予約】海上タクシー遊覧は現地随時受け付けです。
parking: Paid public parking in Ine Town
parkingJa: 【駐車場】伊根町内に有料駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Unique coastal village with 230 traditional wooden boathouses over Ine Bay.

en.name: Ine Funaya Boathouses
en.description: A unique coastal village featuring 230 traditional wooden boathouses built directly over Ine Bay's water level. Often called 'the Venice of Japan', visitors can take sea taxi boat tours.

ja.name: 伊根の舟屋
ja.description: 伊根湾の波静かな海辺に約230軒の舟屋が連続して建ち並ぶ、日本で最も海に近いノスタルジックな集落です。海上タクシーでの周遊や、舟屋見学・地酒蔵元巡りが人気です。
